FAQ

Before you build your system.

Is this just a collection of prompts?

No. Prompting is one component of a broader content workflow covering ideation, writing, repurposing, production, publishing, and AI-assisted systems.

Do I need advanced AI knowledge?

No. The playbook progresses from foundational concepts into practical workflows and frameworks.

Is this a technical automation course?

No. It focuses on designing and using an AI-assisted content workflow rather than deep technical API implementation.

What do I receive?

A 62-page digital PDF playbook containing the frameworks, systems, and prompts described on this page.

Can I use the system with different AI tools?

The concepts focus on workflow design and prompting principles rather than depending entirely on one AI platform.
